01 · Mental model

Why “tests passed” ≠ “coverage reported”

READING CONTROLS
SECTION 01
🎙 Speaking notes English · select Natural / Simpler / Professional above

Code / CIAzure DevOps pipeline
→
Build + TestCoverage collector
→
Coverage reportOpenCover / Cobertura / LCOV
→
Sonar ScannerRead & upload report
→
SonarQubeMetrics & Quality Gate
⇢
Power BIProject KPI dashboard

Three evidence gates

① Test task

Tests are discovered and executed. A TRX file is generated when the test logger is configured.

Passed / Failed / Total
② Coverage collector

A coverage report is generated in a supported format and saved to the expected location.

coverage.* / lcov.info
③ Sonar scanner

The scanner parses the report, matches source files, and uploads the analysis. The server then processes the metrics.

Coverage Report Statistics
Nuance

SonarQube does not execute unit tests. A successful Publish Quality Gate task does not prove that coverage was imported. Depending on its conditions, the Quality Gate may evaluate New Code instead of Overall Coverage.

What SonarQube vs Power BI actually means

SonarQube: Quality, security, and coverage metrics by project key, branch, and analysis. Power BI: A follow-up dashboard that displays retrieved and refreshed metrics. The screenshots do not establish which collector or connector supplies Power BI.

DAX query from the screenshot

Power BI / DAX Query View
EVALUATE
SELECTCOLUMNS(
    FILTER(
        'sonar-latest-metrics',
        ISBLANK('sonar-latest-metrics'[coverage])
          || 'sonar-latest-metrics'[coverage] = 0
    ),
    "Project", 'sonar-latest-metrics'[Project],
    "Coverage", 'sonar-latest-metrics'[coverage],
    "RetrievalDateTime", 'sonar-latest-metrics'[RetrievalDateTime]
)
ORDER BY [Project]
Why blank and zero should be separated

The DAX query combines blank and zero coverage. Blank means no numeric metric in this dataset; zero may be genuine or caused by reporting issues. Verify the project key, latest SonarQube analysis, pipeline logs, and Power BI refresh before concluding.

04 · Key & SonarDT

Unique project key + correct Sonar endpoint

READING CONTROLS
SECTION 04
🎙 Speaking notes English · select Natural / Simpler / Professional above

Sonar project key

projectKey identifies a project on a SonarQube Server. Reusing a key in unrelated pipelines may update the same SonarQube project. The project name is a display label.

ACA screenshot · project identity
projectKey: 'TOM.Dispatch.ACA.Dispatch'
projectName: 'TOM.Dispatch.ACA.Dispatch'

Service connection

Azure DevOps → Project Settings → Service connections → SonarDT (ONE-PWISE screenshot). Verify that this endpoint points to the intended SonarQube instance and that the pipeline is authorized to use it.

ACA screenshot · endpoint wiring
sonarQube:
  enabled: true
  serviceConnection: 'SonarDT'
Watch out

The TomLink classic pipeline screenshot uses SonarDTBis, while other examples use SonarDT. Check each endpoint URL and authorization before treating the difference as a problem. Project key uniqueness applies within each SonarQube Server.

Critical difference

sonar_coverage_exclusions → coverage denominator only; source may still get Quality/Security analysis. sonar_project_exclusions → excludes source files from analysis. Both parameters are forwarded to shared template; property mapping inside _private/sonar-and-dcheck-steps.yml was not uploaded, so confirm its final generated Sonar scanner properties.

Real-world check

Review the exclusion patterns for Bo, Do, Tests shown in the screenshot. Excluding production files from coverage can increase the reported percentage without adding tests. Tech Leads should explain and approve intentional exclusions.

Decision

hasUnitTests: false is present in the screenshot, but its exact runtime effect depends on the shared template _private/sonar-and-dcheck-steps.yml. Do not assume 0% coverage is expected or incorrect without checking the template and speaking to the Tech Lead. Ask: “Is this intentional?”

Critical verification gap

sonar.cs.vscoveragexml.reportsPaths in template points to **/*.coverage, but this property expects Visual Studio coverage XML format (binary .coverage needs conversion). sonar.coverageReportPaths expects generic SonarQube XML, not a raw Cobertura XML. The ReportGenerator SonarQube conversion block in the uploaded file is commented out. Need verify whether another active template creates the expected SonarQube.xml, or configure a supported import path.

Failure visibility

SonarQubePrepare@8, SonarQubeAnalyze@8, and SonarQubePublish@8 all use continueOnError: true in the uploaded shared file. Green pipeline alone is insufficient; open those task logs.

Important conditions

The classic pipeline screenshots show .NET Core 3.1, while the supplied Run Code Analysis log is from a later .NET 10 run. Treat these as two separate snapshots, not evidence of one build. In the TomLink screenshots, Analyze and Publish Quality Gate have the custom condition and(succeeded(), ne(variables['Build.Reason'], 'PullRequest')). These tasks are skipped when Build.Reason = PullRequest, so this configuration does not establish PR coverage reporting.

08 · Formats & exclusions

OpenCover vs Cobertura vs LCOV vs generic SonarQube XML

READING CONTROLS
SECTION 11
🎙 Speaking notes English · select Natural / Simpler / Professional above

ReportTypical stackSonarQube property / actionLive keyword
coverage.opencover.xml.NET with Coverletsonar.cs.opencover.reportsPaths or supported auto-detection scenarioParsing the OpenCover report
coverage.cobertura.xml.NET with Coverlet / Azure DevOpsNot directly the C# OpenCover property; produce supported format or convert to generic SonarQube coverage XMLGenerating report
lcov.infoJavaScript / TypeScript (Vue, React, etc.)sonar.javascript.lcov.reportPathslcov
SonarQube.xmlGeneric coveragesonar.coverageReportPaths and generic schema (not just arbitrary XML filename)sonar.coverageReportPaths
.trx.NET test resultsTest execution results; not itself source coverage dataResults File:

Coverage vs project exclusions

sonar.coverage.exclusions

Exclude from coverage calculation while source can still be analyzed for issues. Changes denominator — KPI can rise without new tests.

Illustrative pattern, not a company default
sonar.coverage.exclusions=**/Generated/**,**/Models/**
sonar.exclusions

Exclude source files from code analysis; other Sonar metrics may also change.

Illustrative pattern, not a company default
sonar.exclusions=**/Generated/**
Never use these as synonyms

sonar_coverage_exclusions and sonar_project_exclusions are parameters in the provided internal shared templates. Check the effective Sonar properties in the prepare step or downstream template. For Vue/JavaScript WebApps, lcov.info is a common coverage format. For ASP.NET Core WebApps, a C# format such as OpenCover is more typical.

EXPECTED QUESTIONS

14 · Q&A

Real technical questions from the screenshots and log evidence

READING CONTROLS
SECTION 14
🎙 Speaking notes English · select Natural / Simpler / Professional above

Why Quality Gate Passed when Overall Coverage is 46.1%?

Quality Gate conditions may be evaluated on New Code and/or other metrics. Check the actual configured gate conditions and code scope; do not assume Overall Coverage has an 80% threshold.

Why does a test task succeed but coverage stay blank?

Tests can pass without a report, or a report may be generated but not found/imported by the scanner. Check the three independent evidence gates.

Is 73 main files with coverage the same as 73 fully covered files?

No. It means the sensor matched coverage data to 73 main files; the percentage depends on covered vs coverable lines/conditions.

Are 13 MSBuild projects with no MAIN nor TEST files errors?

Not by themselves. The scanner found no files classified as MAIN/TEST within those projects for that analysis. Review project inclusion/classification only if unexpected.

Is Cobertura XML directly usable by sonar.cs.opencover.reportsPaths?

No. They are distinct XML schemas. Produce OpenCover format or convert to a supported generic SonarQube coverage report and configure the corresponding property.

Why is the value blank in Power BI but present in SonarQube?

Possible project key mapping, retrieval timing, API collector, dataset refresh or transform issue. Source screenshots do not establish which one; compare keys and timestamps.

Does a WebApp always generate lcov.info?

No. JavaScript/TypeScript frontends commonly use LCOV. ASP.NET Core is C# and commonly uses OpenCover or other .NET-supported coverage formats.

Why does the Analyze log say no coverage found but later import OpenCover?

TomLink TFS Processor could not find TRX/binary coverage in its initial search paths, but the later C# sensor read OpenCover XMLs successfully. Read the full log.

Why hasUnitTests false in PWISE.AF?

The screenshot only proves the value is configured. Confirm with project Tech Lead and check downstream template logic before deciding whether to change it.

Do serviceConnection SonarDT and SonarDTBis point to the same instance?

Not established by the screenshots. Open each service connection, compare URL and permissions; do not assume.

Why is a PR not scanned in classic TomLink?

The screenshots show custom conditions on Analyze and Publish that exclude Build.Reason = PullRequest. Confirm other PR pipelines/branches separately.

publish-webapp-job.yml
parameters:
  - name: 'project' # pattern of project to compile
    default: '*.csproj'
    type: string
  - name: 'testProject' # pattern of project to test
    default: '**/*[Tt]ests.csproj'
    type: string
  - name: 'version' # version give to dotnet-cli
    default: ''
    type: string
  - name: 'informationalVersion' # informationalVersion give to dotnet-cli
    default: ''
    type: string
  - name: sonarProjectKey # used for SonarQube analysis
    default: ''
    type: string
  - name: sonarProjectName # used for SonarQube analysis
    default: ''
    type: string
  - name: sonarScannerMode # MSBuild or CLI
    type: string
    default: ''
  - name: sonar_coverage_exclusions # list of exclude pattern for coverage calculation for example :**/unitests/**/*.cs
    type: string
    default: ''    
  - name: sonar_project_exclusions # list of excluded file(s)/folder(s) from Sonar analysis
    type: string
    default: '' 
  - name: sonar_duplicate_exclusions # list of exclude pattern for duplicate calculation for example :**/unitests/**/*.cs
    type: string
    default: ''
  - name: fwkVersion # .Net framework version
    default: 'net8.0'
    type: string
  - name: sdkVersion # .Net SDK version
    default: '8.0.x'
    type: string
  - name: output # the output of the publish, it will decide the name of the zip file which is published
    default: packages
    type: string
  - name: selfContained # allows to embeed the whole .Net framework with the package
    default: false
    type: boolean
  - name: publishRuntimeIdentifier # OS you target when using self-contained parameter
    default: ''
    type: string
  - name: deployTarget # specify if you are building for an OnPremise IIS project or Azure project
    type: string
    default: Azure
    values:
    - 'Azure'
    - 'OnPremise'
    - 'WebJob'
    - 'WEBAPP&WEBJOB'
  - name: webJobProjectsInfo # specify object with these properties : project, testProject, webJobName, webJobType(Continuous or Triggered)
    type: object
    default: []
  - name: publishProfile # Specify a publish profile (.pubxml)
    default: ''
    type: string
  - name: allowPublishBranch # set to true to allow publishing artifacts
    type: string
    default: 'true' 
  - name: artifactName # name of the output artifact
    type: string
    default: 'packages' 
  - name: restoreUsingConfig # use nuget.config at root in sourcedirectory
    type: string
    default: ''
  - name: forceRunOwasp # force running oWasp, by default is configured to run in nightly mode
    type: string
    default: 'false'
  - name: forceRunSonar # force running Sonar analysis, by default is configured to run in nightly mode, Sonar can only run on default branch
    type: string
    default: 'false'
  - name: defaultBranchName # default branch name, use for sonar if automatic detection failed
    type: string
    default: ''
  - name: hasUnitTests
    type: string
    default: 'true'
  - name: preBuildSteps # steps to execute before building phase
    type: stepList # data type is StepList
    default: []    
  - name: scanAll # Multi-Language analysis
    type: string
    default: 'true'
  - name: sonar_project_inclusions
    type: string
    default: ''
  - name: runSettings
    type: string
    default: ''

jobs:
  - job: PublishWebApp_${{parameters.artifactName}}
    variables:
      - group: Common
      - template: _private/sdk-version-variables.yml
        parameters:
          fwkVersion: ${{ parameters.fwkVersion }}
          sdkVersion: ${{ parameters.sdkVersion }}
          version: ${{ parameters.version }}
          informationalVersion: ${{ parameters.informationalVersion }}
          selfContained: ${{parameters.selfContained}}
          publishRuntimeIdentifier: ${{parameters.publishRuntimeIdentifier}}
          publishProfile: ${{ parameters.publishProfile }}
      - name: hasProjectSpecified
        ${{ if or(eq(parameters['project'], ''), eq(parameters['project'], '*'))}}:
          value: false
        ${{ if and(ne(parameters['project'], ''), ne(parameters['project'], '*'))}}:
          value: true
      - name: allowPublishBranch
        value: ${{ parameters.allowPublishBranch }}
    ${{ if eq(parameters['deployTarget'], 'WebJob') }}:
      displayName: Publish Web Job(s)
    ${{ elseif eq(parameters['deployTarget'], 'WEBAPP&WEBJOB') }}:
      displayName: Publish Web App and Web Job(s)
    ${{ else }}:
      displayName: Publish Web App(s)

    steps:
      - template: _private/sonar-and-dcheck-steps.yml
        parameters:
          forceRunOwasp: ${{ parameters.forceRunOwasp }} 
          forceRunSonar: ${{ parameters.forceRunSonar }}
          project: ${{ parameters.project }}
          sonarProjectKey: ${{ parameters.sonarProjectKey }}
          sonarProjectName: ${{ parameters.sonarProjectName }}
          sonarScannerMode: ${{ parameters.sonarScannerMode }}
          sonar_coverage_exclusions: ${{ parameters.sonar_coverage_exclusions }}
          sonar_project_exclusions: ${{parameters.sonar_project_exclusions}}
          sonar_duplicate_exclusions: ${{parameters.sonar_duplicate_exclusions}}
          version: ${{ parameters.version }}
          hasUnitTests: ${{parameters.hasUnitTests}}
          defaultBranchName: ${{parameters.defaultBranchName}}
          scanAll: ${{parameters.scanAll}}
          sonar_project_inclusions: ${{parameters.sonar_project_inclusions}}
          preBuildSteps: # before prepare analysis of sonarqube
            - task: PowerShell@2
              displayName: Display properties
              inputs:
                targetType: 'inline'
                script: |
                  echo "fwkVersion is '${{ parameters.fwkVersion }}'."
                  echo "sdkVersion is '${{ parameters.sdkVersion }}'."
                  echo "version is '${{ parameters.version }}'."
                  echo "informationalVersion is '${{ parameters.informationalVersion }}'."
                  echo "project is '${{ parameters.project }}'."
                  echo "sonarProjectKey is '${{ parameters.sonarProjectKey }}'."
                  echo "sonarProjectName is '${{ parameters.sonarProjectName }}'."
                  echo "---------------------------------------------------------------------"
                  echo "internalFwkVersion is '${{ variables.internalFwkVersion }}'."
                  echo "internalSdkVersion is '${{ variables.internalSdkVersion }}'."
                  echo "internalVersion is '${{ variables.internalVersion }}'."
                  echo "internalInformationVersion is '${{ variables.internalInformationVersion }}'."
                  echo "internalSelfContained is '${{ variables.internalSelfContained }}'."
                  echo "internalPublishRuntimeIdentifier is '${{ variables.internalPublishRuntimeIdentifier }}'."
                  echo "hasProjectSpecified is '${{variables.hasProjectSpecified}}'."
                  Write-Host 'webJobProjectsInfo is : ${{ convertToJson(parameters.webJobProjectsInfo) }}'
            - ${{ each step in parameters.preBuildSteps }}:
              - ${{ each pair in step }}:
                  ${{ pair.key }}: ${{ pair.value }} 
            - task: UseDotNet@2
              displayName: Install SDK
              inputs:
                packageType: 'sdk'
                version: '${{ variables.internalSdkVersion }}'
            - task: DotNetCoreCLI@2
              displayName: Clear Http Cache
              inputs:
                command: 'custom'
                custom: 'nuget'
                arguments: 'locals http-cache -c'
          buildSteps: # steps after the "prepare sonarqube" and before "run sonar + publish sonar"            
            - template: _private/dotnet-publish-steps.yml
              parameters:
                project: ${{ parameters.project }}        
                testProject: ${{ parameters.testProject }}
                output: ${{ parameters.output }} 
                deployTarget: ${{ parameters.deployTarget }}
                webJobProjectsInfo: ${{ parameters.webJobProjectsInfo }}
                restoreUsingConfig: ${{ parameters.restoreUsingConfig }}
                runSettings: ${{ parameters.runSettings }}
                version: ${{ variables.internalVersion }}
                fwkVersion: ${{ variables.internalFwkVersion }}
                informationalVersion: ${{ variables.internalInformationVersion }}
                selfContained: ${{ variables.internalSelfContained }}
                publishRuntimeIdentifier: ${{ variables.internalPublishRuntimeIdentifier }}
                publishProfile: ${{ parameters.publishProfile }}

          postBuildSteps: # steps after the "run sonar + publish sonar"
            - task: PublishPipelineArtifact@1
              displayName: 'Publish Packages Artifacts'
              inputs:
                ${{ if eq(parameters['deployTarget'], 'WEBAPP&WEBJOB') }}:
                  targetPath: $(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)              
                ${{ if eq(parameters['deployTarget'], 'Azure') }}:
                  targetPath: ${{parameters.output}}
                ${{ if eq(parameters['deployTarget'], 'OnPremise') }}:
                  targetPath: $(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)
                ${{ if eq(parameters['deployTarget'], 'WebJob') }}:
                  targetPath: $(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)
                artifact: ${{ parameters.artifactName }}
                publishLocation: 'pipeline'
              condition: and(succeeded(), and(ne(variables['Build.Reason'], 'PullRequest'), and(eq(variables.allowPublishBranch, 'true'), eq(variables.runAsNightly, 'false'))))
            
            - template: _private/clean-up-steps.yml

jobs:
  - job: PublishAF
    variables:
      - group: Common
      - template: _private/sdk-version-variables.yml
        parameters:
          fwkVersion: ${{ parameters.fwkVersion }}
          sdkVersion: ${{ parameters.sdkVersion }}
          version: ${{ parameters.version }}
          informationalVersion: ${{ parameters.informationalVersion }}
          selfContained: ${{parameters.selfContained}}
      - name: allowPublishBranch
        value: ${{ parameters.allowPublishBranch }}
      - name: disable.coverage.autogenerate
        value: true        
    displayName: Publish Azure Function(s)
    steps:
      - template: _private/sonar-and-dcheck-steps.yml
        parameters:
          forceRunOwasp: ${{ parameters.forceRunOwasp }} 
          forceRunSonar: ${{ parameters.forceRunSonar }}
          project: ${{ parameters.project }}
          sonarProjectKey: ${{ parameters.sonarProjectKey }}
          sonarProjectName: ${{ parameters.sonarProjectName }}
          sonarScannerMode: ${{ parameters.sonarScannerMode }}
          sonar_coverage_exclusions: ${{ parameters.sonar_coverage_exclusions }}
          sonar_project_exclusions: ${{parameters.sonar_project_exclusions}}
          sonar_duplicate_exclusions: ${{parameters.sonar_duplicate_exclusions}}
          version: ${{ parameters.version }}
          hasUnitTests: ${{parameters.hasUnitTests}}
          defaultBranchName: ${{parameters.defaultBranchName}}
          scanAll: ${{parameters.scanAll}}
          sonar_project_inclusions: ${{parameters.sonar_project_inclusions}}
          preBuildSteps: # before prepare analysis of sonarqube
            - task: PowerShell@2
              displayName: Display properties
              inputs:
                targetType: 'inline'
                script: |
                  echo "sdkVersion is '${{ parameters.sdkVersion }}'."
                  echo "version is '${{ parameters.version }}'."
                  echo "informationalVersion is '${{ parameters.informationalVersion }}'."
                  echo "project is '${{ parameters.project }}'."
                  echo "sonarProjectKey is '${{ parameters.sonarProjectKey }}'."
                  echo "sonarProjectName is '${{ parameters.sonarProjectName }}'."
                  echo "---------------------------------------------------------------------"
                  echo "internalFwkVersion is '${{ variables.internalFwkVersion }}'."
                  echo "internalSdkVersion is '${{ variables.internalSdkVersion }}'."
                  echo "internalVersion is '${{ variables.internalVersion }}'."
                  echo "internalInformationVersion is '${{ variables.internalInformationVersion }}'."
            - task: UseDotNet@2
              displayName: Install SDK
              inputs:
                packageType: 'sdk'
                version: '${{ variables.internalSdkVersion }}'
            - task: DotNetCoreCLI@2
              displayName: Clear Http Cache
              inputs:
                command: 'custom'
                custom: 'nuget'
                arguments: 'locals http-cache -c'
          buildSteps: # steps after the "prepare sonarqube" and before "run sonar + publish sonar"
            - bash: |
                cat << 'EOF' > $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/Directory.Build.targets
                <Project>
                  <Target Name="PurgeCrossPlatformRuntimes" AfterTargets="Publish">
                    <ItemGroup>
                      <ExtraRuntimes Include="$(PublishDir).azurefunctions\runtimes\linux-arm64" />
                      <ExtraRuntimes Include="$(PublishDir).azurefunctions\runtimes\linux-x64" />
                      <ExtraRuntimes Include="$(PublishDir).azurefunctions\runtimes\osx-arm64" />
                      <ExtraRuntimes Include="$(PublishDir).azurefunctions\runtimes\osx-x64" />
                      <ExtraRuntimes Include="$(PublishDir).azurefunctions\runtimes\win-x86" />
                      <ExtraRuntimes Include="$(PublishDir)runtimes\linux-arm64" />
                      <ExtraRuntimes Include="$(PublishDir)runtimes\linux-x64" />
                      <ExtraRuntimes Include="$(PublishDir)runtimes\osx-arm64" />
                      <ExtraRuntimes Include="$(PublishDir)runtimes\osx-x64" />
                      <ExtraRuntimes Include="$(PublishDir)win-x86" />
                    </ItemGroup>
                    <Message Importance="high" Text="Pipeline Global Optimization: Purging unused native runtimes..." />
                    <RemoveDir Directories="@(ExtraRuntimes)" />
                  </Target>
                </Project>
                EOF
              displayName: 'Inject Global MSBuild Cleanup Target'
              
            - template: _private/dotnet-restore-steps.yml
              parameters:
                project: ${{ parameters.project }}
                restoreUsingConfig: ${{parameters.restoreUsingConfig}}
                runtime: '--runtime win-x64'
            
            - task: DotNetCoreCLI@2
              displayName: Build to publish
              inputs:
                command: 'publish'
                publishWebProjects: false
                projects: ${{ parameters.project }}
                arguments: '-c Release --no-restore -p:RuntimeIdentifier=win-x64 -p:PublishSelfContained=false -p:SelfContained=false --output ${{parameters.output}} ${{ variables.internalVersion }}${{ variables.internalInformationVersion }}${{ variables.internalFwkVersion }}'
                modifyOutputPath: true # needed when there are multiples projects to publish avoiding merge all publish in same folder
                
            - template: _private/dotnet-test-steps.yml
              parameters:            
                testProject: ${{ parameters.testProject }}
                forceBuild: true
                restoreUsingConfig: ${{parameters.restoreUsingConfig }}
                runSettings: ${{ parameters.runSettings }}

          postBuildSteps: # steps after the "run sonar + publish sonar"             
            - task: PublishPipelineArtifact@1
              displayName: 'Publish Packages Artifacts'
              inputs:
                targetPath: ${{ parameters.output }}
                artifact: ${{ parameters.artifactName }}
                publishLocation: 'pipeline'
              condition: and(succeeded(), and(ne(variables['Build.Reason'], 'PullRequest'), and(eq(variables.allowPublishBranch, 'true'), eq(variables.runAsNightly, 'false'))))

            - template: _private/clean-up-steps.yml

parameters:
  - name: 'project'
    type: object
    # default:
    #   name: '' # Name of the project (ie. The name of the csproj without the extension)
    #   directory: '' # The relative path of the project from the root directory
    #   tests: '' # Name of the test project (ie. The name of the csproj without the extension in the UnitTest directory)
    #   testDirectory: '' # The relative path of the test project from the root directory
    #   sdkVersion: '8.x'
    #   entryPointDll: '' # Optional. Override runtime entrypoint dll (with or without .dll extension)
    #   dockerAdditionalFiles:
    #     - secureFile: ca-cert.pem
    #       imagePath: /app/certs/ca-cert.pem
    #   dockerAdditionalCmd:
    #     - RUN update-ca-certificates

  - name: 'sonarQube'
    type: object
    default:
      enabled: false
      # serviceConnection: 'SonarDT'
      # projectKey: ''
      # projectName: ''
      # inclusions: ''
      # exclusions: ''
      # coverageExclusions: ''

  # When false (e.g. PR builds), skip publish / Dockerfile generation / artifact upload
  - name: 'publishOutput'
    type: boolean
    default: true

  - name: debug
    type: boolean
    default: false

steps:
  # ============================================================
  # Build & Test (always runs — including PR)
  # ============================================================
  - task: UseDotNet@2
    displayName: Install SDK
    inputs:
      packageType: 'sdk'
      version: ${{ parameters.project.sdkVersion }}

  - task: DotNetCoreCLI@2
    displayName: Restore NuGet Packages
    inputs:
      command: 'restore'
      projects: '$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/${{ parameters.project.directory }}/${{ parameters.project.name }}.csproj'
      feedsToUse: 'select'
      vstsFeed: 'd8f6e4b7-a90d-4b20-83f6-3841d32a1992'

  - task: PowerShell@2
    displayName: Calculate report path if unit tests exist
    inputs:
      targetType: 'inline'
      script: |
        $sonarQubeCoverageReportPath = ""      
        if ( "${{parameters.project.tests}}" -ne "" ) {
          $sonarQubeCoverageReportPath = "$(build.artifactstagingdirectory)/TestResults/SonarQube.xml"
        }
        Write-Host "##vso[task.setvariable variable=sonarQubeCoverageReportPath]$sonarQubeCoverageReportPath";  
        $LASTEXITCODE=0

  - task: PowerShell@2
    displayName: Calculate aspnet image tag with dotnet version
    inputs:
      targetType: 'inline'
      script: |
        $aspnetVersion = "FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:8.0-noble"      
        if ( "${{parameters.project.sdkVersion}}" -eq "10.x" ) {
          $aspnetVersion = "FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:10.0-noble"
        }
        Write-Host "##vso[task.setvariable variable=aspnetVersion]$aspnetVersion";  
        $LASTEXITCODE=0

  - ${{ if eq(parameters.sonarQube.enabled, true) }}:
    - task: SonarQubePrepare@8
      displayName: SonarQube Prepare Analysis
      continueOnError: true
      inputs:
        SonarQube: ${{ parameters.sonarQube.serviceConnection }}
        scannerMode: 'dotnet'
        projectKey: ${{ parameters.sonarQube.projectKey }}
        projectName: ${{ parameters.sonarQube.projectName }}
        projectVersion: '$(Build.BuildNumber)'
        extraProperties: |
          sonar.inclusions=${{ coalesce(parameters.sonarQube.inclusions, '') }}
          sonar.exclusions=${{ coalesce(parameters.sonarQube.exclusions, '') }}
          sonar.coverage.exclusions=${{ coalesce(parameters.sonarQube.coverageExclusions, '') }}
          sonar.cs.vstest.reportsPaths=$(build.artifactstagingdirectory)/TestResults/**/*.trx
          sonar.cs.vscoveragexml.reportsPaths=$(build.artifactstagingdirectory)/TestResults/**/*.coverage
          sonar.coverageReportPaths=$(sonarQubeCoverageReportPath)

  - task: DotNetCoreCLI@2
    displayName: Build Project
    inputs:
      command: 'build'
      projects: '$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/${{ parameters.project.directory }}/${{ parameters.project.name }}.csproj'
      arguments: '--configuration Release --no-restore'

  - template: _private/dotnet-test-steps.yml
    parameters:
      testProject: '$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/${{ parameters.project.testDirectory }}/${{ parameters.project.tests }}.csproj'
      forceBuild: true

  # - ${{ if ne(parameters.project.tests, '') }}:
  #   - task: DotNetCoreCLI@2
  #     displayName: Execute Tests 
  #     inputs:
  #       command: 'test'
  #       publishTestResults: false
  #       projects: '$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/${{ parameters.project.testDirectory }}/${{ parameters.project.tests }}.csproj'
  #       arguments: '--configuration Release --no-build --logger trx /p:CollectCoverage=true /p:CoverletOutputFormat=cobertura /p:CoverletOutput=$(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)/TestResults/ --results-directory $(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)/TestResults'

  - ${{ if eq(parameters.sonarQube.enabled, true) }}:
    - task: SonarQubeAnalyze@8
      displayName: SonarQube Run Analysis
      continueOnError: true

    - task: SonarQubePublish@8
      displayName: SonarQube Publish & Quality Gate
      continueOnError: true
      inputs:
        pollingTimeoutSec: '300'

  # - ${{ if ne(parameters.project.tests, '') }}:
  #   - task: PowerShell@2
  #     displayName: Avoid warnings while publishing testsresults
  #     condition: succeeded()
  #     inputs:
  #       targetType: 'inline'
  #       script: |
  #           # PublishTestResults@2 write warning is coverage file is not found in specific sub directory
  #           # expected format
  #           # _buildkitsandbox_2023-07-01_07_33_05/In/buildkitsandbox/coverage.cobertura.xml

  #             $directory = [System.IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName($file.FullName)

  #             $d = Join-Path $directory $file.BaseName "In" "buildkitsandbox"

  #                 (Get-ChildItem $d/*.xml -r) | Write-Host

  #                 Write-Host "Coverage not found: $directory/coverage.cobertura.xml"
  #             }
              
  #           }

  #   - task: PublishTestResults@2
  #     displayName: Publish Test results
  #     condition: succeeded()
  #     inputs:
  #       testResultsFormat: 'VSTest'
  #       testResultsFiles: '$(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)/**/*.trx'

  #   - task: reportgenerator@5
  #     displayName: Generate Code Coverage Report
  #     condition: succeeded()
  #     inputs:
  #       reports:  $(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)/**/coverage.cobertura.xml
  #       targetdir: $(build.artifactstagingdirectory)/TestResults/
  #       reporttypes: 'HtmlInline_AzurePipelines;Cobertura;Badges;SonarQube;MarkdownSummary'

  #   - task: PowerShell@2
  #     displayName: Cleanup Coverage files
  #     condition: succeeded()
  #     inputs:
  #       targetType: 'inline'
  #       script: |
  #           $a=Get-Content $(build.artifactstagingdirectory)/TestResults/Cobertura.xml
  #           $b= $a | select -Skip 2
  #           $c = @($a[0]) + $b
  #           # remove DTD in file
  #           Set-Content -Path $(build.artifactstagingdirectory)/TestResults/Cobertura.xml -Value $c

  #   - task: PublishCodeCoverageResults@2
  #     displayName: 'Publish Code Coverage Report'
  #     condition: succeeded()
  #     inputs:
  #       #codeCoverageTool: 'Cobertura'
  #       summaryFileLocation: '$(build.artifactstagingdirectory)/TestResults/Cobertura.xml'
  #       # To make the task not regenerate the report an environment variable was added to the pipeline in Azure DevOps; "disable.coverage.autogenerate: 'true'"
  #       # see: https://github.com/danielpalme/ReportGenerator/wiki/Integration#attention
  #       #reportDirectory: '$(build.artifactstagingdirectory)/TestResults'

  # ============================================================
  # Publish & Dockerfile Generation (non-PR only)
  # ============================================================
  - ${{ if eq(parameters.publishOutput, true) }}:
    - task: DotNetCoreCLI@2
      displayName: Publish Project
      inputs:
        command: 'publish'
        publishWebProjects: false
        projects: '$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/${{ parameters.project.directory }}/${{ parameters.project.name }}.csproj'
        arguments: '--configuration Release --no-restore --output $(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)/publish /p:UseAppHost=false'
        zipAfterPublish: false
        modifyOutputPath: false

  - ${{ if eq(parameters.debug, true) }}:
    - task: PowerShell@2
      displayName: Debug published output
      inputs:
        targetType: 'inline'
        script: |
          $publishDirectory = "$(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)/publish"
          $entryPointDllParam = '${{ parameters.project.entryPointDll }}'

          Write-Host "================ Published Output Debug ================"
          Write-Host "Publish directory: $publishDirectory"
          Write-Host ""

          if(-not (Test-Path $publishDirectory)) {
            Write-Error "Publish directory not found: $publishDirectory"
          }

          Write-Host "Top-level files:"
          Get-ChildItem -Path $publishDirectory -File | Sort-Object Name | ForEach-Object {
            Write-Host " - $($_.Name)"
          }
          Write-Host ""

          Write-Host "Top-level directories:"
          Get-ChildItem -Path $publishDirectory -Directory | Sort-Object Name | ForEach-Object {
            Write-Host " - $($_.Name)"
          }
          Write-Host ""

          Write-Host "All files (recursive):"
          Get-ChildItem -Path $publishDirectory -File -Recurse | Sort-Object FullName | ForEach-Object {
            Write-Host " - $($_.FullName)"
          }
          Write-Host ""

          Write-Host "Detected runtimeconfig files:"
          $runtimeConfigFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $publishDirectory -Filter "*.runtimeconfig.json" -File
          if($runtimeConfigFiles.Count -eq 0) {
            Write-Host " - none"
          }
          else {
            $runtimeConfigFiles | Sort-Object Name | ForEach-Object { Write-Host " - $($_.Name)" }
          }
          Write-Host ""

          Write-Host "Detected dll files:"
          $dllFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $publishDirectory -Filter "*.dll" -File
          if($dllFiles.Count -eq 0) {
            Write-Host " - none"
          }
          else {
            $dllFiles | Sort-Object Name | ForEach-Object { Write-Host " - $($_.Name)" }
          }
          Write-Host ""

          if(-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($entryPointDllParam)) {
            $expectedDll = $entryPointDllParam
            if(-not $expectedDll.EndsWith(".dll")) {
              $expectedDll = "$expectedDll.dll"
            }
          }
          else {
            $expectedDll = "${{ parameters.project.name }}.dll"
          }

          Write-Host "Expected entrypoint dll: $expectedDll"
          $expectedDllPath = Join-Path $publishDirectory $expectedDll

          if(Test-Path $expectedDllPath) {
            Write-Host "Entrypoint dll check: FOUND"
          }
          else {
            Write-Warning "Entrypoint dll check: NOT FOUND ($expectedDllPath)"
          }

  - ${{ if and(eq(parameters.publishOutput, true), ne(parameters.project.dockerAdditionalFiles, ''), ne(length(parameters.project.dockerAdditionalFiles), 0)) }}:
    - ${{ each additionalFile in parameters.project.dockerAdditionalFiles }}:
      - task: DownloadSecureFile@1
        displayName: "Download Docker additional file: ${{ additionalFile.secureFile }}"
        name: ${{ format('downloadDockerAdditionalFile_{0}', replace(replace(replace(additionalFile.secureFile, '.', '_'), '-', '_'), ' ', '_')) }}
        inputs:
          secureFile: ${{ additionalFile.secureFile }}

      - task: PowerShell@2
        displayName: "Prepare Docker additional file: ${{ additionalFile.secureFile }}"
        inputs:
          targetType: 'inline'
          script: |
            $sourcePath = "$(downloadDockerAdditionalFile_${{ replace(replace(replace(additionalFile.secureFile, '.', '_'), '-', '_'), ' ', '_') }}.secureFilePath)"
            $targetDirectory = "$(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)/publish/.docker-extra"
            $targetPath = Join-Path $targetDirectory "${{ additionalFile.secureFile }}"

            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetDirectory -Force | Out-Null
            Copy-Item -Path $sourcePath -Destination $targetPath -Force

  - ${{ if eq(parameters.publishOutput, true) }}:
    - task: PowerShell@2
      displayName: DockerFile Generation
      inputs:
        targetType: 'inline'
        script: |
            $dockerAdditionalFiles = '${{ convertToJson(parameters.project.dockerAdditionalFiles) }}' | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 100
            $dockerAdditionalCmd = '${{ convertToJson(parameters.project.dockerAdditionalCmd) }}' | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 100
            $entryPointDllParam = '${{ parameters.project.entryPointDll }}'
            $publishDirectory = "$(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)/publish"

            if(-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($entryPointDllParam)) {
              $entryPointDll = $entryPointDllParam
              if(-not $entryPointDll.EndsWith(".dll")) {
                $entryPointDll = "$entryPointDll.dll"
              }
            }
            else {
              $entryPointDll = "${{ parameters.project.name }}.dll"
            }

            $entryPointDllPath = Join-Path $publishDirectory $entryPointDll
            if(-not (Test-Path $entryPointDllPath)) {
              $availableDlls = (Get-ChildItem -Path $publishDirectory -Filter "*.dll" -File | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name) -join ", "
              Write-Error "Entrypoint dll '$entryPointDll' not found in publish output ($publishDirectory). Available dlls: $availableDlls"
            }

            # Separate cert-related file copies from additional commands
            $certCopyLines = @()
            if($dockerAdditionalFiles -ne $null) {
              foreach($additionalFile in $dockerAdditionalFiles) {
                if($additionalFile -eq $null) { continue }
                $certCopyLines += "COPY .docker-extra/$($additionalFile.secureFile) $($additionalFile.imagePath)"
              }
            }

            $certCmdLines = @()
            if($dockerAdditionalCmd -ne $null) {
              foreach($cmd in $dockerAdditionalCmd) {
                if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($cmd)) { continue }
                $certCmdLines += $cmd
              }
            }

            $aspnetVersion = "FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:8.0-noble"      
            if ( "${{parameters.project.sdkVersion}}" -eq "10.x" ) {
              $aspnetVersion = "FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:10.0-noble"
            }

            # Build single-stage Dockerfile
            # Uses full noble image with apt-get upgrade to patch OS-level CVEs
            # Custom certs and additional commands run in the same stage before switching to non-root
            $dockerfileContent = @()

            $dockerfileContent += "# Runtime image (patched, non-root)"
            $dockerfileContent += $aspnetVersion
            $dockerfileContent += "RUN apt-get update && apt-get upgrade -y --no-install-recommends && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*"
            $dockerfileContent += $certCopyLines
            $dockerfileContent += $certCmdLines
            $dockerfileContent += "WORKDIR /app"
            $dockerfileContent += "EXPOSE 8080"
            $dockerfileContent += "COPY . ."
            $dockerfileContent += "USER app"
            $dockerfileContent += "ENTRYPOINT [`"dotnet`", `"$entryPointDll`"]"

            $dockerfile = $dockerfileContent -join [Environment]::NewLine
            $dockerfilePath = Join-Path $publishDirectory "Dockerfile"
            Set-Content -Path $dockerfilePath -Value $dockerfile

            Write-Host "================ Generated Dockerfile ================"
            Get-Content -Path $dockerfilePath | Write-Host

    - task: PublishPipelineArtifact@1
      displayName: Publish application output
      inputs:
        targetPath: '$(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)/publish'
        artifact: 'PublishOutput'
        publishLocation: 'pipeline'

    - template: _private/clean-up-steps.yml
